questions.q: Who was Khadijah's male assistant who went to Sham with the Prophet SAW?
questions.explain: Maisarah accompanied him and was amazed that his character did not change even on a hard journey.

questions.q: Who was the close friend of Khadijah who conveyed her wish to the Prophet SAW?
questions.explain: Nafisa met him and asked why he had not yet married.

questions.q: How old was the Prophet SAW when he married Khadijah?
What was the Prophet's SAW mahr to Khadijah?
questions.explain: He gave twenty young camels as mahr, and Khadijah gave Zaid to him as a gift.

questions.q: Who was the slave Khadijah gifted to the Prophet SAW who chose to stay with him even when his father came?
questions.explain: Zaid refused to go home with his father because he had not met a man more loving than the Prophet SAW.

questions.q: Why did the Prophet SAW take Ali from Abu Talib?
options: Because Ali wanted to learn trade
To ease the burden on Abu Talib's poor family
questions.explain: The Prophet SAW helped a poor family by taking Ali in as his foster son.

questions.q: Of the Prophet's SAW children, who was the only one to die after him?
questions.explain: Fatimah died six months after him. His other children died before him.

questions.q: The Quran forbids attributing an adopted child to the adoptive father, so Zaid went back to being known as Zaid bin Harithah.
questions.explain: True. Verse Al-Ahzab 33:5 commands that adopted children be named after their biological fathers.

questions.q: The Prophet SAW accepted ransom money from Harithah to free Zaid.
questions.explain: False. He refused the ransom and let Zaid choose for himself.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.

items.text: He goes to Sham with Maisarah
He takes Ali in as a foster son

questions.explain: He went to Sham, Nafisa conveyed the wish, Abu Talib and Hamzah proposed, they married, and then he took Ali in.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: A gift from a man to the woman he marries
A child raised as one's own but not given one's lineage
Coming formally to ask for marriage

questions.explain: Tahirah means pure, proposing is coming formally to ask for marriage, mahr is a gift to the wife, and an adopted child does not take the guardian's lineage.

questions.q: A friend invites you to gossip about someone. What example does Khadijah give?
options: Guard your tongue, and never gossip, mock or deceive
Gossip if the person is absent
questions.explain: Khadijah never gossiped, mocked or deceived.
